contexts.text: (The architectonic art in Heaven.) AC 10514:end. HH 185. TCR 740:3. SE 4303.
The architecture of them is such that the art itself is thence... AC 3216. AC 4622. HH 185. CL 12:2. CL 477:4.
Only in the understanding of the architect...
The builders, or architects, who have rejected that stone () are they who are of the Church, here, of the Jewish Church, which has rejected the Lord, and with Him, all Divine Truth.
In the Spiritual Heaven there are magnificent palaces... art there is in its own art, especially the architectonic; from that Heaven many arts in the world derive their laws and harmonies.
